registration.same_day_note: Available during early voting and on Election Day at your poll site

how_to_register.description: Register online at the NY State Board of Elections website.
Download a voter registration form, fill it out, and mail it to your county Board of Elections.
Visit your county Board of Elections office or any state agency that offers voter registration (DMV, etc.).
Register in person at your poll site during early voting or on Election Day.

eligibility: NYS resident for at least 30 days before the election
Not currently incarcerated for a felony conviction

early_voting.hours: Varies by county — check your county Board of Elections
early_voting.how_to_find_site: Visit elections.ny.gov or your county Board of Elections website

eligibility_reasons: Absent from county on Election Day
Temporary or permanent illness or disability
Detention in jail awaiting trial (not yet convicted)

id_requirements.note: Most registered voters in NY do not need to show ID at the polls
id_requirements.first_time_note: First-time voters who registered by mail may need to show ID
acceptable_id: NY Driver's License or Non-driver ID
Government document with name and address
Last 4 digits of Social Security Number

resources.label: Find your county Board of Elections
